name: pulsebridge-web
description: PulseBridge single-page dashboard (Vite + TypeScript, no UI framework).

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs dist http
scripts.build:mock: vite build --mode mock --outDir dist-mock && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs dist-mock mock
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:mock && playwright test --trace off
